label: fed-back "3" as first or second copied token
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase when the input token is the digit 3 being fed back as the first or second copied token (step L+1 with orig(0)=3, or step L+2 with orig(1)=3). Magnitude depends strongly on position: when 3 is the first original token (step right after <DEL>, the echoed 3 is the first input), activation is large (about 0.8-1.0 of max, 83% of mass, 100% precision for that case); when 3 is the second original token, activation is weak (about 0.03-0.35 of max) and fires about 87% of the time. Never fires in the original or delimiter phases, never on other tokens, and essentially never for a fed-back 3 at later copy positions (recall_idx >= 3). Output token, L and correctness do not matter.

issues: The explanation says L has no visible effect. That is false for the weak second-copied-token arm. On the test split, the predicate restricted to (in_tok==3) & (recall_idx==2) has precision 0.000 when L==3 (412 predicted steps), 0.305 when L==4 (2429 steps) and 0.998 when L>=5 (13667 steps). Almost all of the predicate's 2133 test false positives are the short-L recall_idx==2 class. The first shown examples, such as 'q 3 p <DEL> q *3*' and 'e 3 b n <DEL> e *3* b', are L=3 or L=4 sequences.
The explanation says the feature fires on about 87% of second-token steps and treats the misses as unstructured. They are not scattered noise. They are short sequences, a systematic length gate.

The explanation says the output token has no effect, but this cannot be judged for recall_idx==2. There out_tok equals orig(2), and the out_tok==3 subset gave 0.875 precision. That does not separate it from the base rate. This is minor and not refuted.

Confirmed claims: activity is only in the copy phase. In_tok==3 holds 100% of the activation mass. recall_idx==1 has precision 1.0 and holds 83% of the mass. recall_idx>=3 is essentially silent (2 steps). The remaining misses are tiny, at most 0.06 of max and 0.2% of the mass, mostly weak L=4 second-token firings plus a few near-zero activations on other tokens at step 10.
